away.summary: The Devils (11-5-0) are on a back-to-back after a 5-4 overtime win over the Islanders on Saturday. Jake Allen is projected to start the opener of the back-to-back against Toronto on Sunday, with Connor Hellebuyck listed as the backup in the projected lineup. Brenden Dillon is scratched; no other injuries are listed.

home.summary: The Maple Leafs (8-7-2) have lost three of their past four games and begin a stretch of five straight games against playoff-position teams. John Tavares returns to the lineup after missing nine games with a lower-body injury, replacing Dakota Joshua on the second line and rejoining the top power-play unit. Sergei Bobrovsky is projected to start in net, with Artur Akhtyamov backing up; Anthony Stolarz is scratched and will start against the New Jersey Devils on Sunday.
